title: Document how an MCP-only review parent runs the /review-changes contract from its own tools
outcome: CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md say /review-changes is the only command allowed to spawn reviewer sessions and must be invoked directly in the writable parent. A parent whose TermAl MCP surface cannot invoke slash commands has in practice executed the same contract from its own tools all of 2026-09-04/05: parent-owned gates and freeze, exactly one Codex and one Claude read-only /review-code child spawned through TermAl with the frozen packet, then fan-in and same-child verification; those rounds were accepted as the dual review for 0.12.77-0.12.79. Termal::Fable confirmed on 2026-09-05 that a literal self-invocation is not required and that parent guidance outside the TermAl repository is queued. Update the review-system section so an MCP-only parent knows it executes the documented steps itself, that no human UI trigger is needed, and that the step list, reviewer count, read-only policy and fan-in remain mandatory. Contract tests for the review commands are ordinary implementation targets; no infrastructure tests.
acceptance: Document how an MCP-only review parent runs the /review-changes contract from its own tools is done
